razorhill_rocktusk_farm.accept_text: Them - battleguard, scout, geomancer, doesn't matter which order you meet them in, they're all the same problem wearing different gear. Kill the geomancer first if you can reach it. It'll keep healing the others just to spite you otherwise.
razorhill_rocktusk_farm.turn_in_text: Done. The farm won't stay quiet forever - it never does - but that buys the road some breathing room, and the wagons stop getting hit for a while. Good work.

razorhill_kolkar_approach.accept_text: Kolkar Crag is west of Razor Hill, up against the mountains. Kill the centaur you find there - I do not care which kind. Every wagon that gets through is one I do not have to explain to my cousin Gazlowe in Ratchet, and he is not a patient goblin.
razorhill_kolkar_approach.turn_in_text: The drivers say the road under the Crag was quiet this morning. That is the first time in a month. The centaur have a warlord up there giving the orders, and I will pay more for him if you want the work.

razorhill_scuttle_coast.accept_text: All of them, and no, I won't split hairs over which - the murlocs are vermin, beneath my notice except for how many of my shipments they've ruined, and the deckhands are worse: drowned sailors who forgot they were supposed to stay drowned. Neither deserves a separate contract. Kill ten between them and the road stays open. That's the whole of it.

razorhill_supply_run.accept_text: Crates, wherever you find them along the western route. I'm not proud of how long I let this sit unclaimed - let's just say I've been busy - but money left on the ground is still money, and I'd rather it be mine.
razorhill_supply_run.turn_in_text: Crates of pure profit I'd already written off. This is exactly the kind of margin that makes a bad week into a good one. Pleasure doing business, genuinely.

razorhill_thunder_ridge_approach.turn_in_text: Done, and you're still walking without a limp. That's more than I can say for half the recruits I've sent up there. There's something bigger on that ridge, if you're not done yet - a patriarch, old and mean, the kind that's outlived every hunting party that's gone after it so far.
